JdbcParameterColumnMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts a repository method argument or entity field value to a JDBC statement parameter.
    If T is a custom scalar/column type, provide a JdbcParameterColumnMapper<T> component or annotate the parameter/field with @Mapping(...).
    If T is an entity value, check that the query parameter is expanded correctly and that mapper tags match the requested dependency.

JdbcResultColumnMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts one JDBC result column to type T.
    If T is a custom scalar/column type, provide a JdbcResultColumnMapper<T> component or annotate the result field with @Mapping(...).
    If T is an entity result, request/provide JdbcRowMapper<T> instead and annotate the entity with @EntityJdbc when generation is expected.

JdbcRowMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts one JDBC row to entity type T.
    If T is an entity, annotate it with @EntityJdbc so Kora can generate the row mapper.
    Alternative: provide a custom JdbcRowMapper<T> component or annotate the repository method/result with @Mapping(...). Check mapper tags if the dependency is tagged.

JdbcResultSetMapper<T> was not found. This mapper converts the whole JDBC ResultSet to repository method result type T.
    For entity results, Kora usually builds ResultSet mappers from JdbcRowMapper<Entity>; annotate the entity with @EntityJdbc or provide JdbcRowMapper<Entity>.
    For custom result shapes, provide a JdbcResultSetMapper<T> component or annotate the repository method with @Mapping(...).
